mathematical_definition: Rolling lag-1 autocorrelation (numba kernel rolling_autocorr_lag1, imported from features.returns_dynamics -- the one kernel shared across two families) of the nan-to-zero'd Kalman filter residual (kalman_residual_z) over a trailing 60-bar window -- persistence of the mean-reversion residual itself, distinct from persistence of raw returns
numerical_stability_notes: kalman_residual_z is passed through np.nan_to_num before the kernel runs, so any upstream Kalman NaN becomes 0.0 rather than propagating; 0.0 when the kernel's own autocorrelation denominator is below 1e-12
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 60 bars, never zero-filled beyond the upstream nan_to_num applied to the input residual
